title: Chemistry
description: ICSE Class IX Chemistry: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks internal assessment. All reactions are studied with reactants, products, conditions, observations and balanced equations.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Chemistry (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: The Language of Chemistry; Chemical Changes and Reactions; Water; Atomic Structure and Chemical Bonding; The Periodic Table; Study of the First Element - Hydrogen.

sections.title: Chemistry
sections.description: Six units from chemical language to hydrogen.

chapters.title: The Language of Chemistry
chapters.blurb: Symbols, valency, radicals, formulae, balancing equations, relative atomic and molecular mass.

chapters.title: Chemical Changes and Reactions
chapters.blurb: Direct combination, decomposition, displacement, double decomposition; exo/endothermic changes.

chapters.title: Water
chapters.blurb: Universal solvent, solutions, hydrated substances, hardness of water, drying agents.

chapters.title: Atomic Structure and Chemical Bonding
chapters.blurb: Atom constituents, isotopes, octet rule, electrovalent and covalent bonding with orbit structures.

chapters.title: The Periodic Table
chapters.blurb: Dobereiner, Newlands, Mendeleev to the modern periodic law; groups and periods.

chapters.title: Study of the First Element - Hydrogen
chapters.blurb: Position in the periodic table, preparation from water, acids and alkalis, laboratory collection.
